title: Rice blast management trials in Brazil: 2,990 results from 20 Embrapa publications
description: 2,990 trial results from 55 trials on managing rice blast (Pyricularia oryzae, Magnaporthe oryzae) in upland and irrigated rice (Oryza sativa) in Brazil, transcribed from the tables of 20 open-access Embrapa publications (1983-2023): foliar fungicide, seed treatment, resistant cultivars and lines, silicon, nitrogen and potassium, sowing date, furrow irrigation and induced resistance, with trial context (place, season, sowing date, crop system, cultivar, spray timing, design), measured variable and value, assessment stage, and the page and table of origin. Each document was transcribed twice, independently, by AI agents, and every disagreement was settled against the PDF; a human reviewed the result before publication. Part of the Paper Rerun project (Open Tables).
